entries.title: Devices says at once when it cannot look for nearby computers
entries.body: In Settings, on Devices, adding a computer by its address could show Looking for up to 20 seconds after macOS refused local network access (Mac only). It now shows that refusal at once. A look that fails right away, such as on a Linux computer that cannot look on its network, also shows at once. You can still type an address.
entries.noPicture: The lines are already on the address aside. A still picture cannot show an older answer arriving after a newer push.
